#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class Solver {
public:
    void run(int total, int index, istream& in, ostream& out) {
        int n, mod;
        in >> n >> mod;

        vector<vector<long long>> dp(n, vector<long long>(n * n + 5, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                for (int c = 0; c <= i; c++) {
                    if (j - c >= 0) {
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - c];
                        dp[i][j] %= mod;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) dp[i][j] += mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> sumArr(n, vector<long long>(dp[0].size(), 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long long s = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                s += dp[i][j];
                s %= mod;
                if (s == 0) s += mod;
                sumArr[i][j] = s;
            }
        }

        vector<long long> fact(251001, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)fact.size(); i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> nCr(501, vector<long long>(501, 0));
        nCr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 500; i++) {
            nCr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        long long totalRes = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - 2; i++) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long long comb = (nCr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod;
            long long totalSum = 0;
            vector<long long> lastDP = dp[cnt - 2];
            long long ssum = 0;
            for (int j = 2; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                totalSum += sumArr[cnt - 2][j - 2] * (cnt - 1);
                totalSum %= mod;

                long long tempVal = lastDP[j] * totalSum;
                totalRes += tempVal;
                totalRes %= mod;

                ssum += sumArr[cnt - 2][j - 2];
                if (j - cnt - 1 >= 0) ssum -= sumArr[cnt - 2][j - cnt - 1];
                ssum = (ssum + mod) % mod;

                totalSum -= ssum;
                totalSum = (totalSum + mod) % mod;
            }
            totalRes += (sumArr[cnt - 2][0] * comb) % mod;
            totalRes %= mod;
        }
        out << totalRes << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Solver solver;
    int T = 1;
    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        solver.run(T, t, cin, cout);
    }
    return 0;
}
